name: PXA 浏览器
summary: 浏览轻量网页、诗词与资讯订阅，收藏常用网站，并以适宽视图连读漫画图片。
description:
支持 HTTP/HTTPS 轻量网页、中文、书签、浏览历史、页内查找、基础表单和 RSS/Atom 订阅。漫画视图支持翻图、拖动、适宽/适屏、缩放与有界清晰模式，可跟随网页声明的上下章链接。

按需显示 PNG、JPEG 和 GIF，可调整图片与轻量网页脚本开关。暂不支持 WebP、加密切图、完整 CSS、DRM 或复杂现代网站。外部网站的内容和可用性可能变化。

Browse lightweight HTTP/HTTPS pages and RSS/Atom feeds, save bookmarks, revisit history and find text. Read image-based comics with page navigation, width/screen fit, pan, zoom and a bounded detail mode. PNG/JPEG/GIF and limited JavaScript are supported; WebP, encrypted image tiles and full modern-browser compatibility are not supported.

漫画运行截图内容：《小辣椒与萝卜头 / Pepper&Carrot》，David Revoy 及翻译贡献者，CC BY 4.0。原作：https://www.peppercarrot.com/cn/webcomic/ep01_Potion-of-Flight.html；许可：https://www.peppercarrot.com/en/license/index.html。截图为浏览器原始显示。
Comic screenshot credit: Pepper&Carrot by David Revoy and translation contributors, CC BY 4.0; original artwork and license linked above.
changelog:
完善基本表单：修复大写 SUBMIT、普通按钮误提交、禁用按钮和提交按钮值丢失；按 DOM 顺序发送同名字段，统一 UTF-8 表单编码，GET 正确替换旧查询并保留锚点。补充有界 requestSubmit 与 submitter，区分直接 submit 和可取消提交事件，减少字段收集的中间数组与编码回调。图片超限时明确显示预算提示。保留原有资源预算。

Improves bounded form activation, successful submitter values, DOM field order, UTF-8 encoding and GET query replacement. Adds requestSubmit and submitter support, fixes direct submit event behavior, and reduces intermediate arrays and encoding callbacks without increasing resource limits. Image quota failures now show a budget message.
